items.title: Kering stock steadies as Gucci reset supports earnings recovery
items.summary: German financial-wire coverage from August 14 reports Kering's Q2 2026 key-segment revenue reached EUR1.41 billion, down 2% comparable, an improvement on the 5% H1 decline. Frames the stock's resilience on the interplay between recovering Gucci fundamentals, 18% jewelry growth and 8% eyewear growth, plus EUR1.8 billion underlying free cash flow, suggesting Kering's stability now depends on more than Gucci alone.

items.title: Kering stock steadies as Gucci reset lifts earnings
items.summary: A companion German-wire piece from August 14 restates that Gucci's revenue decline narrowed to 2% comparable in Q2 versus a 5% H1 drop, again crediting jewelry (+18%) and eyewear (+8%) for cushioning group results. Notes the stock is 'holding up better than the revenue trend alone might suggest,' i.e., market patience with Gucci is partly borrowed from other divisions' strength.

items.title: Kering shares dip even as Gucci profitability improves and jewellery growth stays strong
items.summary: August 13 German financial-news coverage reports Kering shares slipped about 0.28% on the Paris exchange (EUR57.06) even as Gucci's Q2 revenue decline narrowed to 2% year-on-year and fashion/leather-goods operating margin rose 0.4 points. Jewellery sales grew 14-18% in H1, outpacing fashion. Frames investor sentiment as still cautious despite operational stabilisation -- markets not yet fully convinced the Gucci turnaround is durable.

items.title: Gucci abbassa i prezzi: sara la strategia vincente per Kering?
items.summary: Italian financial-news analysis (Aug 10) argues Kering under CEO Luca de Meo is pursuing an efficiency-first strategy unusual for luxury: analysts estimate the Mercato Tote Bag price was cut 20-25% in early May, part of a broader cost-cutting push (store closures, beauty-division sale to L'Oreal for EUR4bn) that has helped Kering stock outperform LVMH by roughly a fifth since De Meo's arrival. Piece frames this 'accessible luxury' pivot as reputationally risky, comparing the tactic to supermarket-style price competition atypical for a house built on exclusivity.

items.title: "ReconKering": de Meo's plan to double Kering profitability fails to excite the Bourse
items.summary: French financial-market coverage on CEO Luca de Meo's three-phase 'ReconKering' turnaround plan (Reset 2026, Rebuild 2027-28, Reclaim by 2030), targeting closure of 100+ Gucci stores in 2026 (150 more by 2030), renovation of two-thirds of the store network, and a doubling of operating margin to ~22.2%. Included for background context on the restructuring still cited in current earnings commentary; stock fell 2.5% on the announcement day after a prior 9.3% drop, reflecting investor skepticism that 'the buzz precedes concrete sales figures.' NOTE: outside the 14-day freshness window -- retained only as load-bearing background for items 001-003/007-008, not counted as a fresh signal.

items.title: Kering vola in Borsa: i segnali di svolta di Gucci convincono gli analisti
items.summary: Italian markets outlet on Kering's 14% single-day Paris rally (to EUR285.35) after Q2 revenue of EUR3.65bn beat consensus, with Gucci's comparable sales decline narrowing to 2% (a 7-point improvement). HSBC upgraded to Buy (target EUR340); Bernstein stayed more cautious, saying the rally 'already reflects much of the anticipated improvement.' NOTE: outside the strict 14-day window but retained since it is the origin event still actively referenced by the Aug 13-14 wire pieces (items 001-003) -- background continuity, not a fresh standalone signal.

items.title: Kering corre in Borsa (+17%), forte della ripresa di Gucci
items.summary: Italian business-press companion coverage of the July 29 Kering rally, corroborating the stock jump on Gucci's narrower quarterly sales decline; Equita reiterated a Hold rating with a EUR275 target price, a more skeptical read than HSBC's upgrade cited elsewhere. NOTE: outside 14-day window, kept only as corroborating background for the same earnings event referenced across this pool.
